contract_name: Collector V1 Early Opportunity Identification Contract
objective: Identify evidence-supported first-year Collector Booster opportunities before most price appreciation has already occurred.

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: release_price_anchor
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Measure appreciation before gains are already mature.
preferred_sources: certified presale observation when separately labeled

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: historical_first_year_peer_outcomes
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Train and validate early-winner classification and return forecasting.

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: comparable_similarity_scores
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Weight peers by product similarity instead of equal membership only.
preferred_sources: governed comparable pair score artifact created by prior comparable selection workflow

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: historical_supply_snapshots
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Test whether scarcity signals truly identified winners at the historical cutoff.
preferred_sources: other archived marketplace snapshots if already certified
additional_inputs_to_integrate.v1_policy: Optional enhancement; current snapshot may inform current forecasts but must not be backfilled into historical cutoffs.

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: print_and_distribution_proxies
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Improve early supply-risk estimation when direct supply history is sparse.

additional_inputs_to_integrate.name: demand_and_attention_proxies
additional_inputs_to_integrate.purpose: Identify unusual early demand before price history matures.
preferred_sources: marketplace sold-volume data where lawfully accessible
